newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil minister compares Pele to asphalt.
newsitem.headline: Brazil minister compares Pele to asphalt.

text.p: Brazil's transport minister has come under fire for comparing the nation's soccer legend Pele, who is black, to asphalt.
"There are two blacks admired in Brazil. One is Pele, forever our king. The other is King Asphalt, everybody likes asphalt," Eliseu Padilha told reporters at a transport seminar on Thursday.
When they told him his comment sounded racist and asked for an explanation, Padilha said he did not intend to demean Pele but was merely repeating an expression he had heard.
"The racist interpretation made by the press was wrong," Padilha told a local news agency Friday.

Pele, whose name is Edson Arantes Nascimento, is Brazil's sports minister. Although viewed abroad as one of the world's greatest athletes during his long soccer career, he has complained of being subjected to racism back home in Brazil.
About half of Brazil's population is black or mulatto.
